transparency.cleanupFinding: Derived cleanup candidate removes strict-neutral, edge-connected baked checkerboard/grid pixels conservatively while preserving original 1024x1024 layout.

functionalSurfaceBoundary.notes: Functional-surface candidate flags are preserved as planning metadata only. H5.44 does not perform functional slot mapping or runtime UI wiring. H5.45 keeps functional-surface candidates as planning metadata only.

cleanupMethod.summary: Conservative strict-neutral edge-connected background removal per reviewed sourceRect, preserving original sheet layout in a derived RGBA PNG.
cleanupMethod.sourceRectPolicy: Preserve reviewed H5.42/H5.43 sourceRects, including row 2 128x192 protective review bounds.
cleanupMethod.backgroundRemovalPolicy: Only near-neutral checkerboard/grid-like pixels connected to crop edges are made transparent; desaturated colored UI faces such as the clock badge are intentionally preserved.
cleanupMethod.riskPolicy: Fragile FX, glows, sparkles, smoke, dividers, text-bearing UI, laurels, buttons, badges, and label surfaces are flagged for review rather than over-cleaned.
